The '''Korphir Trace''' was a small route between [[Korphir]] and [[Arkuda]] that connected the [[Loop Worlds]] to the [[Back Reach]] within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]. The Trace was the only route to cut through the otherwise impenetrable nebula known as [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]].
